# JACO (Just Autonomous Agent Orchestrator)

> JACO is a user-controlled multi-LLM runtime for persistent mission state, bounded tool execution, verification, audit logging, and local AI orchestration across Termux Android, Linux, and Cloud environments.

## Best Suited For

- Developers building local, hybrid, or edge-based AI autonomous agent systems
- Users requiring persistent agent workflows with PODAR (Perceive-Orient-Decide-Act-Reflect) self-optimization
- Multi-model planning, code critique, AST refactoring, and execution verification
- Android and Termux-based on-device AI agent orchestration with Termux API integration
- Auditable local automation with human-in-the-loop approval gates for system commands and file edits

## Core Capabilities

- **Multi-LLM Orchestration**: Supports Gemini 2.5/3, Ollama (Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek), and OpenAI-compatible adapters.
- **Persistent Mission Memory**: Real-time state synchronization, memory archiving, and audit logging.
- **Mandate-Driven Bounded Execution**: Human-in-the-loop approvals via push notifications (ntfy) for critical shell execution and code modifications.
- **Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol**: Standardized `AgentCard` JSON manifests, task delegation RPC, and P2P marketplace capability discovery.
- **On-Device Android & Termux Integration**: Battery/thermal telemetry, Termux API hooks, local process execution via `executeTerminalAction`.
- **OpenClaw Web Intelligence**: Autonomous web crawling, page scraping, and structured dataset extraction.

## Important Limitations

- JACO does not grant unrestricted Android root or system access beyond user-granted permissions.
- Access to cloud models (e.g. Gemini, OpenAI) requires user-supplied credentials or local model servers.
- Destructive actions or system modifications require explicit user approval.
- Capabilities must be verified against runtime evidence tags (`[REAL]`, `[PROTOTYPE]`, `[SIMULATED]`, `[SPEC]`).
